instruction: Please help me set the tab size in VS Code to 2 spaces.

parameters.command: SETTINGS_PATH="$HOME/.config/Code/User/settings.json"; [ ! -f "$SETTINGS_PATH" ] && echo '{"editor.tabSize": 4}' > "$SETTINGS_PATH" || (grep -q "editor.tabSize" "$SETTINGS_PATH" && sed -i 's/"editor.tabSize": [0-9]\+/"editor.tabSize": 4/' "$SETTINGS_PATH" || jq '. + {"editor.tabSize": 4}' "$SETTINGS_PATH" > temp.json && mv temp.json "$SETTINGS_PATH")

metadata.explanation: Task requires changing VS Code tab size from 4 to 2 spaces. Evaluator uses existing check_json_settings function to verify the editor.tabSize setting in settings.json.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly retrieves VS Code settings.json from the standard location (~/.config/Code/User/settings.json)
Metric (check_json_settings) correctly checks for the expected key-value pair (editor.tabSize: 2) using strict equality
Expected value (editor.tabSize: 2) semantically matches the instruction requirement
Complete coverage: single-step task with appropriate single-property verification
Data flow is correct: file retrieval -> JSON parsing -> key-value validation
Edge cases handled properly: missing file, malformed JSON, missing key, wrong value all return 0.0
Type compatibility: metric expects numeric value for editor.tabSize, which matches VS Code's settings format
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Minor: Consider adding postconfig to ensure VS Code settings are flushed to disk, though VS Code typically auto-saves settings changes immediately
